test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

C _ R W _ _ T R _ N C T _ _ N

options.text: T N C R C W
T C N W R W
T N C W R W
T N C W R T

solution:
Given: C _ R W _ _ T R _ N C T _ _ N

1) T N C R C W → C **T** R W **N -** **C **T R **R** N - C T **C** **W** N

2) T C N W R W → C T R W **C** - **N** T R **W** N - C T **R** W N

3) T N C W R W → C T R W **N** - **C** T R W N - C T R W N

4) T N C W R T → C T R W N - C T R W N - C T R **T** N

 
• Option (3) followed the cycle **"****CTRWN"**

Hence, the correct answer is **" T N C W R W".**
